pairs: A Psalm to the sons of Korah.
and the meditation of my heart will speak prudence.
I will incline my ear to a parable.
I will open my case with the psaltery.
Why should I fear in the evil day?
The iniquity at my heel will surround me.
Qui confidunt in virtute sua, et in multitudine divitiarum suarum, gloriantur.
Those who trust in their own strength and who glory in the multitude of their riches,
He will not give to God his appeasement,
nor the price for the redemption of his soul.
and he will still live, until the end.
when he sees the wise dying:
the foolish and the senseless will perish together.
And they will leave their riches to strangers.
et sepulchra eorum domus illorum in æternum;
And their sepulchers will be their houses forever,
tabernacula eorum in progenie et progenie:
their tabernacles from generation to generation.
vocaverunt nomina sua in terris suis.
They have called their names in their own lands.
when he was held in honor,
He has been compared to the senseless beasts,
and he has become like them.
This way of theirs is a scandal to them.
et postea in ore suo complacebunt.
And afterwards, they will delight in their mouth.
Sicut oves in inferno positi sunt:
They have been placed in Hell like sheep.
Et dominabuntur eorum justi in matutino;
And the just will have dominion over them in the morning.
et auxilium eorum veterascet in inferno a gloria eorum.
And their help will grow old in Hell for their glory.
Verumtamen Deus redimet animam meam de manu inferi,
Even so, truly God will redeem my soul from the hand of Hell,
Ne timueris cum dives factus fuerit homo,
Do not be afraid, when a man will have been made rich,
et cum multiplicata fuerit gloria domus ejus:
and when the glory of his house will have been multiplied.
neque descendet cum eo gloria ejus.
and his glory will not descend with him.
Quia anima ejus in vita ipsius benedicetur;
For his soul will be blessed in his lifetime,
and he will admit to you when you do good to him.
Introibit usque in progenies patrum suorum;
He will even enter with the progeny of his fathers,
et usque in æternum non videbit lumen.
but, even in eternity, he will not see the light.
He has been compared to the senseless beasts,
and he has become like them.
